verdict.rationale: Meltano's own docs say it supports scheduled pipelines, which is a recurring-schedule capability, but that scheduling is orchestrated through Apache Airflow and only one thin line describes it. `meltano run` (docs-37) is a one-off execution, not a recurring schedule, so it adds no credit. Missing for 10: detail on how schedules are defined and managed (cron syntax, schedule commands), native scheduling without Airflow, coverage of non-ELT workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Meltano supports scheduled pipelines that can be orchestrated using Apache Airflow.
